## Homepage map — `bodyandmindon-web`

The homepage is one Next.js App Router page. There is no separate `Hero.tsx`; hero markup, stats, and most sections live inline in `page.tsx`. Background graphics are global via `layout.tsx`.

---

### 1. Hero + constellation / static background

| Item | Path / name |
|------|-------------|
| **Hero markup** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\app\page.tsx` — inline `<section data-scene="hero">` (~lines 95–199), default export `HomePage` |
| **Background (constellation + neural network)** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\components\scene-field.tsx` — `SceneField`, inner `Layer`, `heroPaths()` |
| **Stage wrapper (photo + aurora + vignette)** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\components\stage.tsx` — `Stage` |
| **Scene CSS** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\app\globals.css` — `.scene-field`, `.scene-layer`, `.s-emerald`, `.s-violet`, etc. |

**Structure notes:**
- Hero content: `Badge`, `h1.t-hero`, lead copy, CTA `Button`, then stats + highlight cards.
- Background is **not** in the hero section. `layout.tsx` mounts `<Stage><SceneField /></Stage>` as a fixed `z-index: -1` layer behind all pages.
- `SceneField` renders **static SVG** layers (hero = wobbly contour rings + connected nodes). `IntersectionObserver` on `[data-scene]` sections toggles `data-scene` on `#scene-field` to crossfade layers (opacity/transform only).
- `Stage` adds `/hero-stage.jpg`, gradient overlay, aurora blur, scroll depth `--depth`, and optional cursor glow.

**CSS approach:** Tailwind utilities on the section + global CSS classes in `globals.css`. No CSS modules. Rare inline `style={{ animationDelay }}` on SVG nodes in `scene-field.tsx`.

---

### 2. Stats block — “5 min / 7 dní / 1 číslo”

| Item | Path / name |
|------|-------------|
| **Render site** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\app\page.tsx` (~lines 145–163) |
| **Data** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\lib\content.ts` — `HERO_STATS` |
| **Animated counter** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\components\counter.tsx` — `Counter` |

**Structure notes:**
- Grid: `card mx-auto mt-10 grid max-w-2xl grid-cols-3 gap-3 p-5`
- Each stat: `<Counter to={s.to} suffix={s.suffix} />` + label
- Data:
  - `{ to: 5, suffix: " min", label: "a máš plán" }`
  - `{ to: 7, suffix: " dní", label: "zdarma, platíš 8. den" }`
  - `{ to: 1, suffix: " číslo", label: "týdně stačí" }`
- Sits directly under the hero CTA (“Jak to funguje”), above the 3 highlight link cards.

**CSS approach:** Tailwind for layout/typography; `.card` from `globals.css`; client-side count-up in `Counter`.

- Heading: `badge="Jak to funguje"`, `title="Tři kroky."`, `accent="Žádný chaos."`

- Bottom CTA card: “Začni dnes. Bez chaosu.” + START / ON CLUB buttons

### 4. Page layout / composition

| Item | Path / name |
|------|-------------|
| **Homepage composer** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\app\page.tsx` — `HomePage` |
| **Root layout (global background shell)** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\app\layout.tsx` — `RootLayout` |
| **Reusable section wrapper** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\components\ui.tsx` — `Section`, `SectionHeading`, `Button`, `Badge` |
| **Global styles + design tokens** | `c:\Users\prikopa\Documents\GitHub\bodyandmindon-web\app\globals.css` |

**Composition flow:**
```
layout.tsx
  └── Stage (fixed backdrop)
        └── SceneField (SVG scene layers)
  └── {children} → page.tsx
        └── Nav
        └── main
              ├── hero <section data-scene="hero">  (inline, not Section)
              ├── Section scene="problem" …
              ├── Section scene="system" …
              ├── … (pricing, journey, comparison, etc.)
              └── Section id="jak-to-funguje" scene="autopilot" …
        └── SiteFooter
```

Hero is the only major block using a raw `<section>` instead of `<Section>` from `ui.tsx`; it still sets `data-scene="hero"` for background sync.

---

### CSS stack summary

| Layer | Approach |
|-------|----------|
| **Tailwind CSS v4** | `@import "tailwindcss"` in `globals.css`; utilities throughout JSX |
| **Global component classes** | `globals.css` `@layer components` — `.card`, `.btn-*`, `.stage`, `.scene-field`, `.t-hero`, `.t-lead`, `.wordmark`, etc. |
| **CSS modules** | None |
| **Inline styles** | Minimal (animation delays on SVG nodes; `--mx`/`--my`/`--depth` CSS vars from JS in `Stage`) |
| **Background tech** | Static SVG (not canvas today); hero replacement target is likely `SceneField` hero layer or a new canvas component mounted in `Stage`/`SceneField` |

### Replacement target for animated energy streams

Most likely touch points:
1. **`scene-field.tsx`** — replace hero `Layer` SVG (`heroPaths()` rings + nodes) with a `<canvas>` animation
2. **`globals.css`** — hero-specific canvas styles if needed
3. Optionally keep **`Stage`** photo/overlay or simplify if canvas replaces the full backdrop

Hero **content** stays in **`app/page.tsx`** unless you extract a new `HeroSection` component.
